p.title: A missing 1/5-session return no longer discards a valid durable RRG point
p.symptom: The P1358 producer publishes a CURRENT rotation row with dailyPct or weeklyPct = null when the prior session is absent (its own fixture asserts this), but the consumer required both returns to be finite and dropped the whole row, losing valid rsRatio/rsMomentum coordinates.
p.root_cause: selectProducedRotation validated optional performance fields with the same finite() gate as the RRG coordinates; producer and consumer disagreed on which fields are mandatory.
p.fix: Coordinates stay mandatory; dailyPct/weeklyPct must be a finite number or null. The themes provider marks direction compatibility only when a produced daily return exists.
p.violated_rule: Missing values are not estimated, and a missing optional field must not erase independent valid evidence.
p.prevention: ci-esm-core-unit-check P1366 cases: null returns keep coordinates with pct=null and directionCompatible=false; string/NaN returns are still rejected.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-esm-core-unit-check.mjs OK; real Actions production of rotationHistory is still unobserved (QA-SEMANTIC-ROTATION-01 stays open).

changelog: **RRG 좌표·수익률 분리 (P1366):** 생산된 RRG 행에서 1일/5일 수익률이 없을 때 유효한 좌표까지 버리던 소비자 검증을 수정. 수익률은 null로 유지.
